summary: The diff implements all 7 requirements with good coverage. The backend Motoko actor, all frontend pages, cart functionality, filtering, product detail, about/contact page, and theming are all present. However, the backend is missing stable variable persistence and seed data pre-loading (REQ-4 ACs), and the backend does not expose an explicit remove product update method.

missing_requirements.requirement: Data is persisted in stable variables; Sample seed data with at least 8 products across multiple categories is pre-loaded
missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo uses Map.empty<Text, Shoe>() as a regular variable without the stable keyword, and there are no system preupgrade/postupgrade hooks for persistence. No seed data initialization or pre-loaded products are present in the actor.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend actor exposes update methods to add and remove products
missing_requirements.reason: The backend exposes addShoe but there is no removeShoe or equivalent remove product update method visible in the actor.

hallucinated_features.description: filterByCategory query method exposed on the backend actor
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only asked for list all products and get a product by ID as query methods. A separate filterByCategory query was added beyond the spec.

hallucinated_features.description: Perks/benefits bar section on the homepage with Free Shipping, Easy Returns, Secure Payment, and Premium Quality items
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request did not specify a perks/benefits bar on the homepage. This is additional content not mentioned in REQ-1 or any other requirement.

hallucinated_features.description: Shop-by-category visual image grid section on the homepage
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request specifies a hero section and featured products grid for the homepage, but a separate shop-by-category image grid was added beyond the spec.
